_about: The Inferno's secret wolf spiders (docs/SECRET_WOLF_SPIDER.md). Read by hunters/gimmicks/wolf_spider.rs (the behaviour numbers), game/inferno_secrets.rs (the trigger, lair choice and difficulty plan), render/anim/hunter.rs and audio/world.rs (presentation). Port of config/secret_creatures.gd, hunter_gimmicks/white_wolf_spider_gimmick.gd, black_wolf_spider_gimmick.gd, inferno_secrets.gd and game_3d/creature_view.gd. The hunters themselves are data/hunters/white_wolf_spider.json and black_wolf_spider.json (category "secret": never in the roster draw, the dossier before they are met, or a loading tip).

dossier.white_wolf_spider: [PLACEHOLDER] It lurks where the dark is quiet, barks once to mark you, then runs you down. Shelters stop it.
dossier.black_wolf_spider: [PLACEHOLDER] The darker kin of the white one: hisses instead of barking, ignores your light, and only a shelter or a hiding place stops it.
